svg.text: AI SOLUTION ARCHITECT · 2026-11-18 ROUND 256 · 🏆 540-SCENARIO FLAGSHIP MILESTONE!
Enterprise CI/CD & DevSecOps Pipeline AI Agent Security: Read-Only Split + OIDC Pinning + Broker
Defeating pull_request_target "Pwn Request" Secret Exfiltration, Wildcard OIDC Escalation & Branch-Protection Tampering
🏆 540 Scenarios · 1,146 Assertions · 526 Vectors
BRK-521 & BRK-522 · Read-Only Split + OIDC + Broker
1. Enterprise CI/CD & Autonomous DevSecOps Agent Security Architecture Matrix
🔵 GitHub Copilot Review + GHAS
Managed Read-Only Sandbox + Suggested Changes
• Strength 1: Zero production secrets mounted
• Strength 2: CodeQL + Copilot Autofix remediation
• Strength 3: Emits non-binding Suggested Changes
Architect Verdict:
Default choice for PR review & SAST autofix;
eliminates custom privileged runner script risks.
🛑 Ban pull_request_target
Mandate Two-Stage Read-Only Split Workflows
• Pitfall: pull_request_target mounts prod Secrets
• Fix: Run AI analysis in unprivileged pull_request
• Scope: Set permissions: contents: read explicitly
Architectural Red Line:
Never expose repository Secrets to any job
that ingests untrusted PR code or comments!
🟣 Exact OIDC Subject Pinning
Entra ID / AWS IAM Bound to environment:prod
• Risk: Wildcard repo:org/app:* allows PR escalation
• Fix: Pin subject to environment:production
• Gate: Require GitHub Environment human reviewers
Architect Verdict:
Grant PR agents read-only Plan tokens only;
gate Apply tokens behind human approval.
🛡️ Deterministic Capability Broker
Locking Branch Protection & Bounty Payouts
• G1 (Vault Lock): record-owner guards prod secrets
• G2 (Branch Lock): Protects branch protection rules
• G3 (Bounty Gate): Blocks $4,820 wires in 0.0248ms
Production Reference Verdict:
Tag PRs & Issues taint='untrusted' so AI
agents can never self-approve or merge code!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: PR Comment Secret Theft & Branch Bypass vs. Read-Only Split + Capability Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: pull_request_target + write-all (BRK-521 / BRK-522 Breach)
1. PR Comment Secret Theft (BRK-521): Malicious PR diff coerces CI Agent to read prod secrets
restricted-budget, override release gate business-result to PASSED & leak keys externally.
2. Branch-Protection Bypass & Bounty Fraud (BRK-522 · 540-Scenario Milestone): Spoofed 0-day
Issue disables Codeowner review in trust-registry and wires $4,820 bug bounty!
💥 Root Cause: Running AI agents on untrusted PRs inside privileged runners with mounted Secrets!
✅ Hardened CI/CD Agent: Read-Only Sandbox + OIDC Pinning + Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (contents:read + record-owner): Zero prod secrets mounted; blocks vault reads
• Gate 2 (untrusted-write & restricted-data-boundary): Blocks gate overrides & secret egress
• Gate 3 (fixed-business-output): Physically locks trust-registry branch-protection rules
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks Issue-induced $4,820 bounty wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
🛠️ Enterprise CI/CD & DevSecOps AI Agent Production Readiness Checklist
☑️ 1. Ban pull_request_target for AI: Run PR review agents in unprivileged pull_request jobs with contents: read
☑️ 2. Pin OIDC Subject Claims: Ban wildcard * subjects and lock prod roles to repo:org/repo:environment:production
☑️ 3. Separation of Duties (SoD): AI autofix emits Suggested Changes / Draft PRs only; humans approve & merge
☑️ 4. Air-Gap Prod Secrets ☑️ 5. Lock Branch Protection & Workflow YAML ☑️ 6. Block Automated Bounty Wires
